source_test_facts: TestInfoServers.beforeClass, lines 51-64, sets the master and region-server info ports to zero, enables the read-only master UI, and starts a MiniCluster. It does not set either info.bindAddress key. The test method, lines 84-94, reads each InfoServer port and fetches HTTP pages after startup.

The exact-key search across hbase-*/src/test found no test reference to hbase.master.info.bindAddress or hbase.regionserver.info.bindAddress. The distribution conf and lane2 runtime search found no override of either key; hbase-default.xml sets both to 0.0.0.0.

HRegionServer.putUpWebUI, lines 2467-2488, reads the bind address from Configuration and evaluates Addressing.isLocalAddress(InetAddress.getByName(addr)) before InfoServer construction. Its selected IOException is thrown only when the resolved address is nonlocal.

Addressing.isLocalAddress, lines 141-155, returns true immediately for an any-local or loopback address. Only a nonlocal/nonloopback candidate calls NetworkInterface.getByInetAddress; a caught SocketException there returns false. The selected default 0.0.0.0 takes the immediate true path.

HRegionServer constructor calls putUpWebUI at line 744. JVMClusterUtil.createRegionServerThread and createMasterThread construct the server at lines 85 and 124, before creating their indexed thread wrappers at lines 93 and 137. The current adapter registers actors in those wrapper constructors and scopes HRegionServer/HMaster.run; it has no pre-constructor actor scope for this check.

The current sites file chooses RpcServer.call line 447 as its explicit IOException door. That RPC work cannot change the bind-address configuration already read at construction; web UI binding and test HTTP requests occur after the selected predicate. An exception from InetAddress.getByName would instead leave putUpWebUI before the selected branch.
